commands: If a competition slug exists: {sa} -w "{ws}" kaggle info --competition <slug> --json
Optionally read the cached profile at .sa/profile.json.
scout.guidance: If data is not frozen or the objective is not locked, status="blocked" and explain the exact missing step. Populate cv_recommendation from the profile: time column -> time; group candidates -> group; classification -> stratified; else kfold.

templates.tabular_optuna.py: time-boxed LightGBM tuning for the tune operator (copy _contract.py too); binary, multiclass, regression
templates.text_tfidf_linear.py: TF-IDF word+char n-grams with a linear model (copy _contract.py too); text classification and regression
templates._contract.py: shared helper for the two templates above: frozen folds, metrics, the output contract

notes.hypothesis: Propose falsifiable modeling strategies. The independent variable is one of: feature set, model family, preprocessing, CV design, ensemble, or ablation. Predict the metric delta vs the current best/baseline; isolate the variable with controls, seeds, and CV; state cost and leakage risk. No test labels, no public leaderboard probing, no external data unless the objective allows it. Prefer a baseline first; do not propose another baseline if one exists. Name each candidate's operator (draft, improve, debug, ablate, tune, merge), its idea family, and its parent runs; fill the controller's work slots first.
notes.engineer: Read data only from SA_DATA_DIR; write only to SA_OUTPUT_DIR. Emit metrics.json, prediction_oof.csv, prediction_test.csv, folds.csv, cv_design.json. Do not fabricate metrics. Do not read holdout labels. Use SA_DATA_DIR/cv_folds.csv for cross-validation when it exists, so runs pair fold by fold and their OOF files can be ensembled.
